title: 第1章 混沌至宝初苏醒多宝强拉入截教第2章 林镜拜入截教中通天教主赐灵宝
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
在洪荒世界的深处，有一处不为人知的山脉，长久以来，这里被茂密的原始森林所覆盖，山峦叠嶂，云雾缭绕，仿佛是天地间最后的未解之谜。
然而，就在一个平凡的午后，这片宁静的山脉突然爆发出了前所未有的异象，一股滔天的气息如同沉睡的神兽苏醒，瞬间席卷了整个区域。
这股气息强大而古老，仿佛携带着混沌初开时的原始力量，让人不禁心生敬畏。随着这股气息的爆发，山脉中涌现出了各种祥瑞之兆。
只见天空中，五彩斑斓的霞光交织，形成了一道道绚丽的彩虹，它们如同桥梁般连接着天地，美得令人窒息。
而地面之上，无数灵花异草在瞬间绽放，散发出迷人的香气，吸引着各种珍稀的飞禽走兽前来观赏，它们在花间翩翩起舞，构成了一幅和谐共生的美丽画卷。
而正在不远处的一个山谷之上，一只眼冒精光的老鼠笑眯眯的朝着那个方向冲了过去！
“哈哈哈哈！果然有异宝出世！不枉老道我早有预感，在这里等上了足足一个会元！”
只见那只肥硕的老鼠一个闪身就消失不见，这速度即使是圣人见了恐怕也瞠目结舌！
不错，此鼠正是截教上清圣人通天教主的大弟子——多宝道人！
可是看着眼前不断出现的种种惊天异象，多宝道人也产生了一丝疑惑？
“就算是先天灵宝出世，也不会有这么大的反应吧？不得了！不得了啊！这里面到底诞生了什么宝贝啊？”
思绪翻飞之际，多宝道人的速度又加快了一倍！
可是在这些特殊异象的阻拦之下，多宝道人一时间也无法进入山脉之中！
作为洪荒第一只寻宝鼠，在拜入截教之前，他就已经收集了诸多法宝了！
更何况，如今的他早已斩却二尸，实力达到了准圣后期！
早在一个会元之前，他就心有所感，预感了此处将会诞生一件法宝！
可是预感平时的法宝出现，基本上几十年就会诞生了！
但是现在这件法宝，却足足让他等待了整整一个会元！
而此时此刻，在山脉的正中央！
一道人影缓缓凝聚成型，看着周围不断爆发的各种围绕着他的异象！顿时警觉的喊道：

“都散了，快快快，都散了！”
看着随着自己心念一动就全部消散的各种异象，林镜终于松了一口气！
这里可是传说中的洪荒啊，那个金仙多如狗、准圣满地走的洪荒世界啊！
这么招摇不要命了吗？
还好随着林镜的话音刚落，那些各种各样的异象都刹那间消失不见了！
林镜感受了一下体内的实力，似乎是天仙初期！
还不错，至少不用像凡人一样从炼精化气开始一步步修炼了！
不过这点实力恐怕也就能欺负一下凡人了，在洪荒世界根本就不值一提！
话说现在是什么时期啊！女娲有没有把人族创造出来啊？
“坑爹的系统，你就是这么玩我的吗？”
没错！作为一个穿越者，林镜也遇到了属于他的系统！
也正是拜这个系统所赐，他直到现在才苏醒过来！
此刻，不远处的多宝道人看着忽然消失的种种异象大惊失色！难不成这异宝已经被别人得到了吗？
可是以他的实力，除非是圣人亲自出手，不然不可能在他眼皮子底下就这么把宝物取走的！
当今世上，成为圣人的只有道祖鸿钧，三清，女娲，以及准提和接引！
三清自从分家之后，太上老君留在首阳山八景宫，元始天尊留在昆仑山玉虚宫。
通天教主则在东海金鳖岛碧游宫开辟道场！
平时三清根本不会出门，女娲自从造人之后也宅在娲皇宫！
只有准提和接引圣人天天哭喊着西方贫瘠，到处在洪荒世界之中闲逛，遇到什么东西都说：
“你与我西方教有缘！”

想到这里，多宝道人不由得再次加快了速度，没有种种异象阻挡，他很快就到达了这片山脉的中心！
content_en:
In the depths of the prehistoric world, there is an unknown mountain range. For a long time, it has been covered by dense virgin forests. The mountains are stacked and covered with clouds and mist, as if it is the last unsolved mystery between heaven and earth.
However, on an ordinary afternoon, an unprecedented phenomenon suddenly erupted in this peaceful mountain range. A monstrous aura was like a sleeping beast awakening, sweeping across the entire area in an instant.
This aura is powerful and ancient, as if it carries the original power of the beginning of chaos, which makes people feel awe. With the explosion of this aura, various auspicious omens emerged in the mountains.
In the sky, the colorful rays of light intertwined, forming brilliant rainbows. They connected the sky and the earth like bridges, and they were breathtakingly beautiful.
On the ground, countless spiritual flowers and plants bloomed in an instant, exuding a charming fragrance, attracting all kinds of rare birds and animals to come and watch. They danced among the flowers, forming a beautiful picture of harmonious symbiosis.
And in a valley not far away, a rat with gleaming eyes rushed towards that direction with a smile!
"Hahahaha! Sure enough, a strange treasure has been born! It's true, I had a premonition, and I've been waiting here for a long time!"
The fat rat disappeared in a flash. Even a saint would be stunned at this speed!
Yes, this rat is Taoist Duobao, the great disciple of the leader of the Jie Sect, the Sage Tongtian!
But looking at the various shocking phenomena that kept appearing in front of him, Taoist Duobao also had a trace of doubt?
"Even if an innate spiritual treasure is born, there won't be such a big reaction, right? Incredible! Incredible! What kind of treasure is born here?"
As his thoughts were racing, Taoist Duobao's speed doubled again!
However, blocked by these special visions, Taoist Duobao was unable to enter the mountains for a while!
As the first treasure-hunting rat in the world, he had already collected many magic weapons before joining the Jie Cult!
What's more, now that he has killed two corpses, his strength has reached the late stage of Quasi-Saint!
As early as one Huiyuan ago, he had a feeling in his heart and had a premonition that a magic weapon would be born here!
But I have a premonition that the usual magic weapon will be born within a few decades!
But now this magic weapon has made him wait for an entire Huiyuan!
And at this moment, in the middle of the mountain range!
A figure slowly condensed into shape, looking at the various strange phenomena that continued to erupt around him! Suddenly he shouted alertly:
"It's all gone, hurry up, hurry up, it's all gone!"
Lin Jing finally breathed a sigh of relief as he saw all the various visions disappearing as soon as he thought about it!
This is the legendary prehistoric world, a prehistoric world where golden immortals were as numerous as dogs and quasi-sages roamed the earth!
Are you so arrogant that you will risk your life?
Fortunately, as soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, those various visions disappeared in an instant!
Lin Jing felt the strength in his body, it seemed to be in the early stage of immortality!
Not bad, at least you don’t have to start practicing step by step from refining Qi like ordinary people!
However, this level of strength is probably enough to bully ordinary people, and it is not worth mentioning in the prehistoric world!
By the way, what time is it now? Did Nuwa create the human race?
"This is a cheating system. Is this how you play with me?"
That's right! As a time traveler, Lin Jing also encountered his own system!
It was thanks to this system that he didn't wake up until now!
At this moment, Taoist Duobao not far away was shocked when he saw all the strange phenomena that suddenly disappeared! Is it possible that this rare treasure has been obtained by someone else?
But with his strength, unless the saint took action himself, it would be impossible to take the treasure away right under his nose!
In the world today, the only saints are Daozu Hongjun, Sanqing, Nuwa, Zhunti and Jieyin!
Since the separation of SanqingAfter returning home, Taishang Laojun stayed in the Bajing Palace in Shouyang Mountain, and Yuanshi Tianzun stayed in Yuxu Palace in Kunlun Mountain.
The leader of Tongtian Cult opened a dojo in Biyou Palace on Jinliu Island in the East China Sea!
Normally, Sanqing would not go out at all, but Nuwa has also stayed in the Wa Palace since she created humans!
Only the saints Zhunti and Jieyin cried out every day that the West was barren, wandering around in the ancient world and saying to everything they encountered:
"You have a connection with my Western religion!"
Thinking of this, Taoist Duobao couldn't help but speed up again. Without all kinds of strange phenomena to stop him, he quickly reached the center of this mountain range!
